title: Executable standard phase sequence and start gate
userStory: As a contract-operations product owner, I can verify that each phase follows the same evidence-backed sequence and cannot start over unresolved integrity or audit defects.
businessRules: All ten execution steps remain ordered and a later step cannot finish before an earlier step.
An active or complete phase requires a completed predecessor and no unresolved data-integrity or audit-trail defects.
nonGoals: The gate does not judge the substantive quality of evidence or prove that a command ran on a particular commit.
The gate does not add contract runtime schema, API, storage, or interface behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Malformed, incomplete, reordered, prematurely advanced, or blocked phase manifests fail with a non-zero exit code.
A complete phase with all ten steps accounted for, existing evidence, and a clear start gate passes locally and in pull requests.

steps.rationale: This repository-governance phase adds a manifest schema but makes no D1 contract-data schema or migration change.
The checker is local and CI-only, introduces no HTTP endpoint, and performs no database or object-storage write.
The phase introduces a non-interactive repository gate whose accessible output is plain text with explicit pass and fail labels.

evidence.ref: 10 of 10 execution steps explicitly accounted for

metric.name: Roadmap 15 execution steps explicitly accounted for
metric.value: 10 of 10 steps (100%); workflow evidence coverage, not production outcome quality
